user.title: Set up UGREEN NAS
user.description: Enter the connection details for your UGREEN NAS.

data_description.ugreen_host: The IP address or hostname of your UGREEN NAS (e.g. 192.168.1.100).
data_description.ugreen_port: Port used for the connection (default: 9999 for HTTP, 9443 for HTTPS).
data_description.password: Your NAS admin password (no special characters – UGOS bug!).
data_description.entity_prefix: Must start with a letter; then letters, numbers, and spaces are allowed.
data_description.use_otp: Tick this only if the NAS account above has 2FA enabled. You will be asked for one code on the next screen, used to register Home Assistant as a trusted device so it never needs a code again.

zeroconf.title: UGREEN NAS discovered
zeroconf.description: A UGREEN NAS was automatically discovered on the network. Enter your credentials to add it.

otp.title: Register Home Assistant as a trusted device
otp.description:
Your NAS account uses two-factor authentication. Home Assistant cannot answer a code prompt every time it reconnects, so it registers itself once as a trusted device.

Enter a current code from your authenticator app. It is used immediately and never stored.

Device ID that will be registered: `{client_id}`

This ID is generated and managed automatically. You do not need to note it down or enter it anywhere.

data_description.otp_code: The current 6-digit code from your authenticator app. Codes expire quickly, so submit promptly.

error.cannot_connect: Connection failed. Please check the IP address, port and network connection.
error.invalid_auth: Connection error or invalid credentials. Please check network and user settings.
error.invalid_entity_prefix: Invalid device name. It must start with a letter; afterwards only letters, numbers, and spaces are allowed.
error.entity_prefix_in_use: This device name is already used by another UGREEN NAS.
error.invalid_otp: Registration failed. The code may have expired or been mistyped, or the account may not have 2FA enabled. Check the logs and try a fresh code.

abort.already_configured: This UGREEN NAS is already configured.

init.title: UGREEN NAS settings
init.description: Change the connection and authentication settings for your UGREEN NAS.

data_description.ugreen_host: The IP address or hostname of your UGREEN NAS.
data_description.ugreen_port: Port used for the connection (default: 9999 for HTTP, 9443 for HTTPS).
data_description.password: Your NAS admin password (no special characters – UGOS bug!).
data_description.entity_prefix: Must start with a letter; then letters, numbers, and spaces are allowed.
data_description.use_https: Use an encrypted HTTPS connection (requires HTTPS port).
data_description.use_otp: Leave unticked for normal changes. Tick it and save only if the NAS account uses 2FA and Home Assistant is not registered yet, or you need to register again. You will be asked for one code on the next screen.

otp.title: Register a trusted device
otp.description:
Enter a current code from your authenticator app to register this Home Assistant with the NAS. The code is used immediately and never stored.

Current device ID: `{client_id}`

This ID is managed automatically and is deliberately not editable. If logins start failing after revoking trust on the NAS, simply register again here.

data_description.otp_code: The current 6-digit code. Codes expire quickly, so submit promptly.
